result.description: Fires on the plural suffix 's' after a noun stem, most strongly "truth" + s ("truths") in logic and math text. It stays silent on 's' inside words (impossibility), verb -s and possessive 's.
result.label: Plural 's' in "truths"

result.description: Fires on the first word after "interaction(s)/interplay between", as the first element of the pair (Earth, a, organ-, gla-, elect-). It stays silent on ' Earth' in other constructions, such as "the Earth's atmosphere".
result.label: Word after "interaction between"

result.description: Fires on the split-word piece ' aw' (before "areness"), mainly after a modifier like phonemic/phonetic/environmental, and on "-B[ased]". Silent on ' aw' after a conjunction or verb in intercultural-communication text.
result.label: ' aw' in "…awareness" after modifier

result.description: Fires on connectives (' and', quote marks, ' as', commas) inside lists of grammar terms or quoted words in English-grammar/linguistics text, e.g. lists of conjunctions. Silent on ordinary 'and' in regular prose about writing.
result.label: List connectives in grammar text

result.description: Fires on the noun or quantifier after "no" in "no two X" (e.g. "no two electrons/fermions"), as in the Pauli exclusion principle. It stays silent on "up to two" and "a two-state".
result.label: "no two" in exclusion-style statements

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Qu' when it begins a split word like Quadrilaterals, Quadratic or Quality. It stays silent when ' Qu' follows 'Total' or 'BAME', where it is a mid-compound piece.
result.label: ' Qu' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like " personal", " bi" (biases, biological), "obi", "auto-bi" that are likely followed by a suffix continuing the word. Silent when "personal" starts a word directly (personalisation at document start).
result.label: Word-start pieces: personal, bi-

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ulate' in "regulate" (also 'ates', 'ulating') when a subject regulates something, mostly in biology or biochemistry text. Members detect regul-/ulate/ulation pieces and regulatory vocabulary. Silent on "plays a crucial role in" contrast.
result.label: 'regulate' verb ending 'ulate'

result.description: Fires on the verb or noun ' impact' (also ' affect', ' influence') right after a comma or clause, often as a participle-like continuation (", impacts on", ", impacting"). Silent on 'impact' after 'the', 'direct' or 'to'.
result.label: ' impact' after comma clause

result.description: Fires on ' to' right after "analogous" (analogous to). Silent on ' to' in other constructions such as "in addition to", "likened to", or infinitive "to". Members mostly detect the "analog-ous" word pieces.
result.label: ' to' after "analogous"

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'iast' (in ecclesiastical) and 'atr' (in theatrical), word fragments that are followed by an '-ical' suffix. Members detect other word-start fragments that precede suffixes like -ical.
result.label: Word fragments before -ical (iast, atr)

result.description: Fires on the word or slot right after "remains" or "still" (e.g. "remains a", "still a", "still serve") when a subject is said to persist as something. Silent on "is a" or "serving as a". Members detect remain/still tokens.
result.label: Continuation after remains/still

result.description: Fires on the word " employee" used as a modifier before a noun (employee engagement, turnover, productivity) in workplace/HR text. Members detect "employee" and "staff" tokens and workplace context.
result.label: ' employee' as noun modifier

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after a verb or noun of viewing or regarding (view X as, describe as, seen as), introducing how something is characterised. Silent on comparative 'as...as' and on 'not as' or 'sometimes as'.
result.label: 'as' after view/regard verbs

result.description: Fires on the plural noun ' thoughts', usually after a possessive or determiner ("their thoughts", "the thoughts of"). It stays silent on the singular 'thought' in "between thought and feeling". Members detect thought, idea and mind-related words.
result.label: ' thoughts' plural noun

result.description: Fires on varied connective or list-continuation tokens (and, which, all, in) and some mid-phrase words within lists of items in academic or expository text. It stays silent on some 'and' tokens after commas in lists. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: List connectives in expository text

result.description: Fires on word pieces (etic, ological, inter-, emot-, -ic) that begin or continue an abstract adjective/noun right after the adjective "profound". Silent on 'etic' in words like poetic, genetic, aesthetic.
result.label: Word pieces after "profound"

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after the copula "is" in a predicate-nominal slot ("is the culmination/metaphor/confluence"). It stays silent on ' the' after other words such as prepositions or verbs, and also in some "is the" contexts.
result.label: ' the' after "is"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ber' when it ends a word started by an earlier piece, strongest in "fi|ber" (fiber materials, fiber optics), weaker in "cy|ber" and "straw|berries". It stays silent when 'ber' starts a text.
result.label: 'ber' after fi- / cy- prefix

result.description: Fires on the word " central" when it follows "the" or a similar determiner mid-sentence, mostly in "the central bank" and "central charge". It stays silent when " central" is the first token of the document.
result.label: " central" after determiner
Standalone verb 'listen' / 'listening'
result.description: Fires on ' listen' and ' listening' as a whole word, especially the verb in imperatives or advice about attentive listening, and predicts adverbs like 'closely'. Silent when 'listen' is a word piece in 'listeners'. Members detect listen/listening and related tokens.

result.label: ' aw' piece in 'awareness'
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' aw' when it begins the word "awareness" (e.g. "environmental aw|areness"). It predicts the continuation 'aren'. Members are mostly detectors of the same ' aw' token.

Fires on the suffix of "advancements"/"advances" (ements, ances, ancement), typically as a subject noun before "in <field>" in scientific or technological history. Silent in one case after "intellectual advancements," so context matters.
result.label: advancements/advances suffix token

result.description: Fires on the middle pieces of the split name "Kolmogorov" (mainly 'm' and 'og' after "Kol"/"Kolm"). Also fires on similar mid-name pieces (Schrödinger, Bernoulli, Manhattan). It stays silent when 'm' starts the word without "Kol" before it.
result.label: Kolmogorov name-piece 'm'/'og'
Word "model" in named models
result.description: Fires on the token " model"/" Model" (also the stem of "modeling"), especially after a modifier in named models or techniques such as Waterfall Model, fluid mosaic model, predictive modeling. Silent on contrast text without the word.

Fires on a standalone space token that precedes a number, such as a digit sequence in "the 1s", "the 11th", or "the 12th". It also fires between numbers in lists. It stays silent on some similar "the 12th" contexts, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Space token before digits

result.description: Fires on the conjunction ' until' (occasionally ' before') when it follows a verb or clause describing an ongoing action or state, introducing the time limit. Members are detectors of until, before and after.
result.label: ' until' temporal conjunction

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' chem', ' sculpt', ' art' right after "digital" or "computational" (digital art, digital sculpture, computational chemistry). Silent on "chem" in plain chemistry contexts without that modifier.
result.label: digital/computational + art/chem/sculpt

result.description: Fires on ' on' or ' the' right after "mark" in the idiom "left an indelible mark on (the)". Members detect 'mark' tokens and ' the'; the same ' the' elsewhere stays silent.
result.label: preposition after "left a mark"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' im' when it is a mid-text word start, mostly in 'imputation' (also 'imputed', 'imbuing'), following a preceding word. It is silent when ' im' is the first token of the document.
result.label: ' im' piece in imputation

result.description: Fires on " the" right after "some of" (also weaker after "one of", "half of"), typically leading into a superlative like "most". Stays silent on " the" after other words or prepositions.
result.label: "the" after "some of"

result.description: Fires on the article ' an' (sometimes ' a') right after a verb that requires an object, such as necessitate, signifies or require. It is silent on ' an' after prepositions like 'from' or 'between'.
result.label: Article 'an' after demanding verbs

result.description: Fires on the 'ces' (or 'cing') piece completing "introduces"/"introducing", where the verb brings in a new concept or idea. Silent on 'ces' in other words such as "audiences".
result.label: introdu-ces / introdu-cing suffix

result.description: Fires on the final piece of a word or noun (packaging, sourcing, recycling, Design) that follows "eco-friendly" or similar green/sustainability wording. Members are recycling, waste and green-energy detectors.
result.label: Eco-friendly noun completion

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ce' inside the word "oceans" (after "o"), and weakly on 'ce' in similar mid-word positions like "scarce". Silent when 'ce' starts a word or follows other pieces, as in "coalesce".
result.label: 'ce' inside "oceans"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ont' inside "deontology/deontic/deontological", and weakly in "spontaneous". It needs the preceding "de" or "sp" piece, and it predicts word-continuation pieces like "ological".
result.label: 'ont' in deontology

result.description: Fires on the prefix " under" (also 'under' pieces) when it starts a compound word like underfitting, underperformance or understatement, or sits in a quoted "under" mention. It stays silent on "undergo" after "must".
result.label: under- prefix in compounds
"ors" in "directors" (board)
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ors" completing "directors", mostly in corporate board governance text (executive/non-executive directors). Stays silent on "ors" in other words like "investors".

Fires on the 's' of a decade plural (1980s, 1990s) that is the second item in a range or list of decades, e.g. "1970s and 1980s", "1920s to early 1950s". Silent on a lone decade like "the late 1980s".
result.label: Decade 's' ending a range

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ced' at the end of "sourced", especially in "locally sourced". It stays silent on 'ced' in "evidenced". Upstream members detect 'ced'/'cing' pieces and local-sourcing context.
result.label: 'ced' in "locally sourced"

result.description: Fires on pieces after "et" (or, 's, arian) in words like "etoric", "etarianism", where the word is split into fragments starting with "et". Stays silent on "or" in "Rhetor-ic", so it needs the "et"+piece split.
result.label: "or" piece after "et" fragment

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'ac' (cacophony, polysaccharides, adjacency) and 'ian' (variances) inside a longer multi-piece word, after a word-start piece such as c, var, polys. Silent on ordinary whole words.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'ac'/'ian'

result.description: Fires on the articles " a" / " an" right after a copula "is" in a definitional predicate ("X is a crucial aspect/form of..."). Silent on "a" after prepositions like by, towards, as.
result.label: Article 'a' after "is"

result.description: Fires on function words (mostly " to", also " with", " the", " can make") right after "users" as the object of allow/enable/ensure verbs, in user-experience and interface text. Silent on " to" after other nouns such as researchers or customers.
result.label: function word after "users" in UX text

result.description: Fires on ' which' as a non-restrictive relative pronoun after a comma following a named theory, concept or technical term in academic or explanatory text, introducing a clause about it. Silent in some physics/chemistry contexts.
result.label: Relative 'which' after named concept

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' mem' (memoir, memories, memo) as it begins a longer word. Members are detectors of ' mem' and of other word-start fragments. It pushes the next token towards 'ories'.
result.label: ' mem' word-start fragment
Mid-word pieces of Greek-derived terms
result.description: Fires on word-internal fragments early in a long technical word, mainly 'omed' in "Biomedical" and 'phen' in "hyphenation"/"phenomena", where the next piece continues the word (e.g. 'ical'). Weaker on other mid-word fragments like 'ov' in "stereovision".

Fires on the word-initial piece ' bi' / ' Bi' that starts bio- words (biomedical, biological, biogeographic, biology). Members are detectors of this same piece. The contrast shows it stays silent on unrelated text.
result.label: Word-initial 'bi' of bio- words

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments inside longer words, mainly 'age' in "wage" and ' fer' in "fermentation". Upstream members detect the 'w'+'age' piece and ' fer' piece. Logits are not clearly meaningful.
result.label: wage / fermentation word pieces

result.description: Fires on ' following' (and ' beginning') right after "the", when it is a determiner-like word introducing what comes next ("the following", "the beginning"). Members detect following/followed, beginning/starting/introduction and given.
result.label: "the following" / "the beginning" after the

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' fu' in "fossil fuels" (predicting "els"), and also on the digit '3' at the start of numbers like dates (3400, 3500) or list items. Weaker on other word-start pieces like 'icon' and 'Trad'.
result.label: ' fu' in fossil fuels, and '3'
' util' word-start piece
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' util' at the start of words like utilization, utilize, utilitarian, and occasionally ' incorpor'. Members are mostly ' util' and ' use' token detectors. The contrast text has no such word piece.
Fires on the piece 'cular' when it completes the word "molecular" (mole+cular). It stays silent on 'cular' in prefixed words such as "macromolecular" and "intramolecular".
result.label: 'cular' in "molecular"

result.description: Fires on ' not' in the fixed phrase "including, but not limited to". It stays silent on ' not' in "not only" or "is not merely" constructions.
result.label: "but not" in "not limited to"

result.description: Fires on the verb ' act' (also ' acting') as a standalone word, typically after a subject or modal ("they act as", "must act"). Silent when 'act' is the start of a word like "actively".
result.label: Verb 'act' as standalone word

result.description: Fires on abstract intellectual nouns like "ideas", "principles" and "concepts", mostly after an adjective or modifier, in history-of-thought or science text (e.g. "basic ideas", "early concepts"). Silent on the Enlightenment-literature contrast passage.
result.label: Ideas/principles/concepts nouns after modifier

result.description: Fires on the first token or word piece of the object after "approach to" (e.g. "a" in "a|esthetics", "curr|icul|um", "sour|cing", "narr|ative"). Silent on ' a' as a standalone article after other words.
result.label: Word start after "approach to"

result.description: Fires on ' mean' as the statistical average (the mean, sample mean, near the mean), in statistics text. It is silent on sentence-initial "mean" with no statistical context before it, and only weakly active on "meanings".
result.label: statistical 'mean' (average)

result.description: Fires mainly on " sous" in the cooking term "sous vide", predicting a continuation piece. It also fires weakly on word-start pieces in cooking and food text, such as "pas|try". Members are cooking and culinary detectors.
result.label: " sous" in sous vide cooking

result.description: Fires on word pieces that continue the word "monoton-" (monotonic, monotonicity, monotonous, Monotype), i.e. the suffix after "monot". Members include monot/on token detectors.
result.label: suffix pieces of "monoton-" words

result.description: Fires on the 'll' piece inside the word "syllable(s)" (sy|ll|able), in linguistics text about syllable structure. Silent on 'll' in other words such as "you'll" or "llalabries".
result.label: 'll' in syllable

result.description: Fires on "ining" in "examining" (and on " examine"), i.e. the scholarly verb of analysing or investigating something. It stays silent on "ining" in other words like "redefining" or "imagining".
result.label: examining / examine verb

result.description: Fires on the token after "richness" (' of', ' and') or the end of rich-words like "bounty", in phrases such as "richness of diversity". Members detect "rich"/"-ness" tokens. It stays silent on ' of' elsewhere.
result.label: Token after "richness" (of/and)

result.description: Fires on the noun " transformation" (occasionally " shift" or " transition") as a change-of-state noun, typically after "underwent a significant/revolutionary". Members are detectors of transformation/transform tokens across many contexts.
result.label: ' transformation' noun after "underwent a"

result.description: Fires on the object word or adjective right after a verb of seeking or wanting (seeks, sought, wanted, hoping), such as "innovative", "new", "authentic", "warm". It is silent on the same word pieces in other contexts.
result.label: Object after seek/want verbs

result.description: Fires on a stray 's' token that follows a sentence-ending period with no space, as in "development.s like Facebook". It looks like a glitchy fragment that starts a new word. It stays silent on plural 's' attached to a noun.
result.label: Stray 's' after period

result.description: Fires on the word right after "heated" (by, to, ly) in physics text about heating, e.g. "The Earth's surface is heated by". Members detect heat/temperature and "heating" words. Silent on "by" after other verbs like dictated or characterized.
result.label: Preposition after "heated"

result.description: Fires on the word "modern"/"Modern" as an adjective in phrases like "modern atomic model", "modern era", "modern times". Members are mostly detectors of modern/current/contemporary. Silent on the synonym "contemporary".
result.label: word "modern"

result.description: Fires on tokens following the word piece "ech" in speech-technology terms (ech synthesis, ech-to-text, ech recognition), e.g. " synth", "-", " recognition". Stays silent on hyphens in other words like real-time.
result.label: Speech-technology term after "ech"
' eth' piece before 'ical'
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' eth' when it starts a word like "ethical" or "ethics" in mid-sentence, after words such as "of", "the", "and". It is quieter after "virtue" and at document start. Members are mostly ' eth' token detectors.

Fires on verbs or modals (had, should, must, becoming) right after a subject noun like "curricula" in education/teaching text, e.g. "it became clear that curricula had to be revised". Members are mostly education/teaching context detectors.
result.label: Modal verb after curricula subject
"in" inside "fascinating"
result.description: Fires on the piece "in" inside "fasc-in-ating/ated" (also similar mid-word pieces like "intr-igu-ing"). Stays silent on "in" in other words such as "reminiscent" or "Michelin". Predicts suffix pieces like "ating".

Fires on the word piece right after "high-resolution" (e.g. mult-, spect-, imag-, D) when it starts an imaging or spectroscopy term. A member detecting "resol" drives it. It stays silent on "mult" in other contexts, such as "multidisciplinary".
result.label: Word after "high-resolution" (imaging/spectroscopy)

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ical' (sometimes 'ic') completing "geotechnical", in engineering text. It stays silent on 'ical' in other words like empirical, mechanical, ecological, biogeochemical.
result.label: geotechn-ical suffix
Verb/preposition after "effectiveness" subject
result.description: Fires on the function word (' on', ' is', ' be', ' by') right after a subject like "the effectiveness of X" (depends on, is measured). Silent on ' on' in other contexts, such as "depends on" without the effectiveness subject.

Fires on the token right after "such" (" an", a word-start fragment like "dist", "roph", "urd", or a noun), where a "such X that/as" construction is being set up. It stays silent on " an" after other words.
result.label: Token after "such"

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-start piece " combin" before "atorial" in math text about combinatorics. It also fires weakly on other word-start fragments such as "igen" and " St". Its inputs are detectors for combin- and related word pieces.
result.label: " combin" before -atorial

result.description: Fires on ' and' (sometimes ' or') joining two abstract nouns in a coordinated pair, often at the start of a document or title (e.g. "Debt and equity", "Education and democracy"). Silent on some ' and' in similar pairs, so the extra requirement is unclear.
result.label: ' and' between paired abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on the piece after "Br" inside rare names and words, mainly the 'n' in "Brønsted" (also 'ou' in Brouwer). Silent on ordinary text. Members detect "Br" plus following pieces like 'us' and 'id'.
result.label: Br-prefixed name middle piece (Brønsted)

result.description: Fires on 'ance' in "surveillance" and on ' monitoring' (and similar), in technical text about monitoring, sensing and testing. It stays silent on 'ance' in other words such as finance, governance, enhance and reliance.
result.label: surveillance / monitoring terms

result.description: Fires on word pieces that start a positive-quality word after "a"/"an" or similar, mainly " delight" (as in "a delightful"), also "igu" (intriguing) and "eleg" (elegance). It predicts suffix continuations like "iful".
result.label: delight/intrigue/elegance word starts
Hyphen after "free"
result.description: Fires on the hyphen token right after "free" (free-rider, free-range, free-market, free-morpher). It stays silent on hyphens after other prefixes such as non-, under-, and shape-. Members detect "free" and its variants (freezes, freezing) plus generic hyphens.

Fires on ' diffusion' and nearby tokens in passages about cultural diffusion (e.g. the word itself, the following process/comma/can). Silent on 'turbulent diffusion' in a physics fluid context, so it seems to need the cultural/social setting.
result.label: Cultural diffusion topic word

result.description: Fires on the piece 'pt' inside "pe-pt-" in peptide/peptidyl/peptidoglycan. It stays silent on 'pt' in "apoptosis", so it needs the preceding "pe" prefix.
result.label: 'pt' in peptide words

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ites" completing "composites" (materials science text, fiber-reinforced composites, alloys). Members detect "composite", "material" and "ites" tokens. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "ites" in composites

result.description: Fires on a plural noun (often plural 's' or words like symbols, vehicles, instruments) right after "serve/act/function as", naming what something serves as. Predicts a following "for/into" phrase. Silent on ordinary plurals elsewhere.
result.label: Plural noun after "serve as"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "otic" completing "asymptotic" (asympt|otic), in math/computer-science analysis text. Members detect "otic" pieces and related math tokens like Big O.
result.label: "otic" in "asymptotic"

result.description: Fires on the token ' best', mostly in "best practice(s)" after a preposition or verb. It predicts continuations like practice, case, action. Weak firing on adverbial "best engage".
result.label: ' best' before practice(s)

result.description: Fires on the token ' ones' used as a pronoun-like noun replacing a previously mentioned noun, usually after an adjective ("vibrant ones", "best-looking ones"), and in "oneself" forms. Members are mostly ' ones' detectors.
result.label: ' ones' after adjective

result.description: Fires on the word right after "a key/important/crucial factor in" (mostly " the" or " in", sometimes a word start like "agricult"), where the next word names what is influenced. Silent on " the" in other constructions.
result.label: Token after "factor in"

result.description: Fires on 'phase', 'stage' or 'step' when it names a numbered or ordinal step in a multi-step process, such as 'second phase' or 'final stage'. It stays quiet on 'phase' in a descriptive use like 'transformative phase'.
result.label: Process phase/stage after ordinal

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ulation' when it completes the word "modulation" (signal or voice modulation). It stays silent on 'ulation' in simulation and articulation, so it needs the "mod" prefix.
result.label: 'ulation' in "modulation"

result.description: Fires on ' half' (occasionally ' part') right after "the second" as in "the second half of...". It stays silent after "latter" (latter half), so it needs the ordinal "second" before it.
result.label: "second half" after ordinal

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ult' inside "cultural" (socioc-ult-ural, interc-ult-ural, C-ult-ural). Members are mostly detectors of 'ult' after a 'c' prefix. Weakly fires on 'lect' in "eclectic".
result.label: 'ult' in "cultural" word piece

result.description: Fires on word pieces (' t', 'icul', 'phon', ' intr') that begin or continue a fancy word in the flowery opening of a document, like "In the intricate tapestry of". Silent on ' t' in mid-text words like tension or tune.
result.label: Word pieces in flowery essay openings

result.description: Fires on list separators (commas, slashes, "and") and on the word "age" in lists of demographic variables like "age, gender, ethnicity" or "age/gender". Silent on commas in other lists, such as research topics or disease terms.
result.label: Demographic list: age and separators

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ual' completing "bilingual" / "multilingual" (as in bilingualism), after the 'iling' piece. It is silent on some 'ual' occurrences in similar words, so the exact condition is not clear.
result.label: 'ual' in bilingual/multilingual

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ism' (also 'ist', 'istic') when it completes the word "humanism"/"humanist". It stays silent on 'ism' in other words such as scholasticism or neoclassicism.
result.label: -ism suffix in humanism

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of a longer word that is still incomplete, such as 'pron' in pronouns, 'tra' in traits, and 'in' in Multinomial. Silent on 'in' inside other words like molinellary or distinctions.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (pron, tra, in)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ar' right after 'plan' (planar, planarity), and more weakly on ' plan' itself. It needs the preceding 'plan' token; standalone 'ar' stays silent. Members detect ' plan' and 'plan-es' tokens.
result.label: 'ar' completing 'planar'
-ity suffix in elasticity
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ity' completing technical nouns, strongest in "elasticity" (economics/physics). It stays silent on 'ity' in words like electricity, scarcity, equity, vigority.

Fires on " Revolution" right after "Industrial" (Industrial Revolution). Members detect "Indust"/"rial" pieces and industrial-themed words. It stays silent in at least one "During the Industrial Revolution" context, and the reason is unclear.
result.label: Industrial Revolution's "Revolution" token

result.description: Fires on the word piece " dead" when it begins a longer word such as deadlock or deadline, where the next piece is expected to complete the compound. Mostly in technical text about concurrency and scheduling.
result.label: ' dead' in deadlock/deadline

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'al' completing "element" (elemental analysis), and weakly on " and" after "elemental". It stays silent on 'al' in other words like reveal, thermal and instrumental.
result.label: 'al' in "elemental"

result.description: Fires on the token "order" in "first-order" and "second-order" logic, after a hyphen. It fires weakly on "order" inside "disorder" and in "order" linguistics. The circuit is mostly "order" detectors plus "logic" context.
result.label: "order" in second-order logic

result.description: Fires on the word or word piece right after the degree adverb "too" (too hard, too soft, too talkative, too intricately, too much, too excessive), i.e. the adjective/adverb being modified. Silent on "over" in unrelated uses like "overboard" or "excitement over".
result.label: Word following "too"

result.description: Fires on the token ' object' as a modifier in computer-vision phrases like "object recognition/detection/tracking", predicting words such as detection or recognition. Weaker on "objectives" and "direct objects".
result.label: ' object' in object recognition

result.description: Fires on word pieces in molecular/atomic chemistry and physics text, such as "orbit" in molecular orbitals, "cular", "geometry", "struct" and "trans" in spectroscopy. Members detect chemistry terms like molecule, orbital and electron.
result.label: Molecular chemistry term fragments

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after an agent-noun in the plural or singular, such as conductor, rulers, orchestrators, transporter, in the "the X of Y" metaphor. Stays silent on ' of' after abstract or process nouns like tradition, part, design, execution.
result.label: ' of' after agent nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' hier' at the start of words like hieroglyphs, hierarchy, hieratic, where the next piece completes the word. Members are detectors of ' hier' and similar word-start fragments.
result.label: ' hier' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (e.g. 'istic', ' the', ' vocal', 'itive') in texts about the Renaissance period and intellectual history. It is silent on 'istic' after 'art' in other contexts, so it needs Renaissance-era context.
result.label: Renaissance-period text, varied tokens

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ities'/'ity' completing "dispar-" (disparities/disparity), in economic or social inequality text. Silent on 'ities' in other words such as "opportunities".
result.label: disparity suffix -ities/-ity

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'ag' in Pythagorean and similar words, plus 'conjug' and 'ate' in technical or mathematical terms. It is silent on 'ag' in Epicthagoratic, so it needs specific word contexts.
result.label: Pythagorean 'ag' word-piece

result.description: Fires on " the" right after a verb like describe/discuss/detail/explore in expository "this section will describe the…" text, where an abstract topic noun phrase comes next. Silent on "the" after other verbs or prepositions in other prose.
result.label: "the" after section-outline verbs

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after "Law" (e.g. "Law of Sines", "First Law of Thermodynamics"), weakly after "laws". Stays silent on ' of' after other nouns like range, field, realm, conservation.
result.label: ' of' after "Law"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ract' inside longer words such as detract, distract, refract and retractable, after a prefix piece (det-, dist-, ref-). Members mostly detect 'ract' and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'ract' word piece (detract/distract/refract)
'id' piece in "humidity"
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'id' in the middle of "hum-id-ity" (humidity in climate/forest text), expecting 'ity' next. Silent on 'id' at the start of a document or word, so it needs a preceding word piece such as 'hum'.

Fires on the 'isions' piece of "collisions" when the preceding context is about elasticity (e.g. "elastic collisions"). It stays silent on "collisions" without an elastic context. Elastic-detecting members (the 'astic' pieces) drive it.
result.label: 'isions' in elastic collisions

result.description: Fires on the "els" piece of "excels" (and on " in" right after "excels"), in technical text where something "excels in" a task. Members detect "exc"+"it"/"els" word pieces.
result.label: "excels" (in) token piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ocracy" completing "democracy" (after "dem"). Members detect "dem-ocracy", "democr-atic", "liberal" and political-governance words.
result.label: 'ocracy' in "democracy"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ce' completing "sauce" (sau|ce), in cooking text. Weakly fires on similar word-final pieces like 'ze' in glaze. Members detect the 'ce' piece and cooking-related word fragments.
result.label: 'ce' in "sauce"

result.description: Fires on the possessive "'" or "s" right after the name Pascal (Pascal's Triangle/Theorem), weakly after other famous names like Smith. Silent on possessives after common nouns like triangle's or theorem's.
result.label: Possessive after Pascal

result.description: Fires on the word " experiment" (also "experiments"), most strongly in physics or science contexts such as the double-slit or thought experiment. Members are mostly detectors of experiment-related tokens. The target pushes down repeating "experiment".
result.label: ' experiment' token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on " Berlin" in "Berlin Wall"/"Berlin Airlift" contexts, and on the word piece " au"/" Au" in "auctions". Members detect Berlin, Germany and Soviet tokens. It is silent on some "auction" contexts.
result.label: Berlin (Wall/Airlift) and au(ctions)

result.description: Fires on the token ' T' when it is a standalone letter or abbreviation, such as T cell subtypes (T_H), TP/TQ variables, or a T symbol in math and science text. It stays quiet on 'T' in 'TUI technology'.
result.label: Standalone ' T' letter/abbreviation
Word-start piece 'hum' (humidity, humorous)
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' hum' when it begins a longer word such as humidity, humidifiers, humid or humorous. Silent when ' hum' starts the document with no preceding context. Members are mostly ' hum' detectors in earlier layers.
Fires on ' Chinese' and on the ' Ch' piece of 'Chain' in repeated "Supply Chain" headings, plus China/Asian-type words. Members are detectors for Chinese/China/Ch tokens. Weak elsewhere.
result.label: Chinese / Ch token detector

result.description: Fires on ' to' right after "used"/"is often used" (also "a way to", "intended to"), where it introduces an infinitive of purpose. It stays quiet on prepositional 'to' such as "refers to" or "ratio to".
result.label: purpose infinitive 'to' after used

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces ('astic', 'ol', 'op', 'o') inside words like scholastic, schizophrenia, after the 'sch' start. Silent when 'ol' starts the word or follows a capitalized 'Sch' in some contexts.
result.label: Mid-word piece after 'sch'

result.description: Fires on " this" used as a demonstrative determiner after a comma, before an abstract noun like approach, analysis or inquiry. It also fires on "ic" in "synergetic". It stays silent on "this" in some other positions, such as a pronoun use or a sentence start.
result.label: Demonstrative "this" before abstract noun

result.description: Fires on the piece "find" inside "wayfinding", "wayfinders" and "pathfinding", right after "way" or "path". Members mostly detect "find" and other word-start pieces that get completed into longer words.
result.label: "find" in wayfinding

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' intr' when it begins "intricate/intricacies", typically after "the" or "an" in academic-style text. It is silent on 'intr' in "intrinsic". It pushes towards 'icate'-style continuations.
result.label: ' intr' starting "intricate"

result.description: Fires on the end of "Einstein" ('stein') and the following possessive "'s" when a possessive/theory name follows, as in "Einstein's General Relativity". It stays silent on "Einstein" in other positions, such as before a verb or in a list.
result.label: Einstein possessive before theory

result.description: Fires on the word "consumption" (and related tokens like "patterns", "ases", and "and" right after consumption) in economics text about consumption and spending. Stays silent on "and" in ordinary lists of policies or goods.
result.label: Consumption in economics text

result.description: Fires mainly on the token ' orbit' (and orbit-related pieces) in astronomy or physics text about orbiting bodies and orbitals. Members are mostly orbit/orbital token detectors plus space-related words such as astronaut and celestial body.
result.label: ' orbit' token in astronomy text

result.description: Fires on 'ideology' and its continuations (ologies, ology, following words like 'is', 'emerged') and related -ism/-ical tokens in political or philosophical text. Silent on some 'ide|ologies' cases, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Ideology word pieces, political philosophy

result.description: Fires on the continuation pieces of the word "stereotype(s)" (ype, ypes, ot) after "stere"/"stereot". Members detect the "tere"/"stere" prefix. It also fires weakly inside other stereo- words like stereochemistry and stereo vision.
result.label: stereotype word continuation

result.description: Fires on ' to' right after "thanks" (and more weakly after "due"), i.e. the "thanks to" / "due to" prepositional phrase. Silent on ' to' after adjectives or nouns like "possible to", "ability to", "crucial to".
result.label: "to" in "thanks to" / "due to"

result.description: Fires on ' adv', ' progress' or ' develop' (start of advancements/developments) right after "-ological" words like "technological" or "sociological". Silent on the same tokens after other preceding words.
result.label: advancements after "-ological" words

result.description: Fires on the determiner (' the', ' this', or a space before a year) right after "during", where a time period or era is expected (e.g. "during the 19..."). Silent after "in", "since", "as".
result.label: Determiner after "during"

result.description: Fires on the word right after "in terms" (mostly " of", sometimes " their" or " [" after "in terms of"), i.e. the slot introducing the respect in which something is compared. Silent on " of" in other noun-of phrases.
result.label: "in terms of" continuation

result.description: Fires on the word " character"/" Character" in lists or contrasts of categories (e.g. "Character vs. ..."), where it is a standalone item. It stays silent on "character development" in fiction-analysis text.
result.label: character as listed category item

result.description: Fires on "person" (or "third"/"-") in "close third-person" narration, driven by members detecting the word "close". It stays silent on "second-person", "first-person" and plain "third-person" without a preceding "close".
result.label: "close third-person" narration

result.description: Fires on the token ' data' when it is the object of a verb like analyzing, collecting, capturing or interpreting. It stays silent when ' data' is a modifier before another noun (data management, data processing). Members are mostly ' data' detectors.
result.label: ' data' as object noun

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (word endings, ' in', 's') inside a "one of the most ..." superlative phrase, within the adjective or following phrase. Predicts continuations like ' another'. Silent on ' in' after "change/shift".
result.label: "one of the most" superlative phrase

result.description: Fires on " Systems"/" System" as the final word of a capitalized multiword name or term, such as Global Positioning System or Geographic Information Systems. It stays silent on unrelated text.
result.label: Capitalized "System(s)" in proper names

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' when it completes "Decolon-ization", helped by upstream colonial/colon detectors. It stays silent on 'ization' in other words such as Globalization, nationalization, Optimization and reorganization.
result.label: Decolonization 'ization' suffix

result.description: Fires mostly on the word "modify" (and nearby list slots like "and"/"," after "modify nouns") in grammar-style or change-related text. Members detect modify/alter/change/modification word variants.
result.label: "modify" and change-verb words

result.description: Fires on " or" (also "ing" and commas) right after the noun "disinterest" / "uninterest" in passages about body language and communication cues, e.g. "may signal disinterest or resignation". Silent on " or" after other nouns.
result.label: "or" after disinterest (body language)

result.description: Fires on the word " musical" (also Music/Musical), mostly as an adjective before a noun like "instruments" or "activities". It is silent in some cases, such as at the start of a text or after "folk", so it seems to need a preceding context word.
result.label: Adjective " musical" before nouns

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside longer words, mostly 'opol' in geopolitics and monopoly, also 'nt' in sovereignty and 'ig' in sovereignty. It is silent when 'opol' starts the text with no 'ge' or 'mon' before it.
result.label: Mid-word 'opol' piece (geopolitics, monopoly)

result.description: Fires on the preposition (' on', ' through', ' into') right after "walking" or similar motion verbs, especially in "like walking on/through ..." figurative comparisons. Silent on 'on' after verbs like "think back" or "keeping you".
result.label: Preposition after walking/moving verbs

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' prov' at the start of a split word, mostly 'providers' or 'provisions' after 'healthcare', 'care' or 'insurance'. It is silent on nearby text without that piece. Members are detectors of other word-initial fragments.
result.label: ' prov' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' the' that begins a new item after a comma in a list of institutions, states, or historical entities (e.g. "Plato and Aristotle, the tragedies"), or after an introductory clause. Silent on ' the' after prepositions or in "one of the".
result.label: ' the' after comma in lists

result.description: Fires on ' complex' as an adjective right after "a"/"is a" (e.g. "is a complex process/field"). Silent when it starts a text or follows "more" or "and". Weaker on 'intricate'.
result.label: "a complex" adjective after article

result.description: Fires on the word "humor" (also "humour", "sarcasm" pieces, "jokes", "wit") in texts about humor and sarcasm. Members are mostly humor/laugh detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: humor and sarcasm words

result.description: Fires on ' for' (sometimes ' to') right after "the time it takes", introducing the infinitive-like clause ("takes for half of atoms to..."). Silent on ' for' after nouns or adjectives like "support for" or "advantageous for".
result.label: "it takes for" construction

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "polynomial" (equations, functions, hyphen, comma, form, word pieces). It needs "polynomial" as the preceding word; "diophantine equations" and "differential equations" leave it silent.
result.label: Token following "polynomial"
Word-start ' mult' (multi- prefix)
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' mult' (multi-, as in multifacet, multilingual, multinomial), predicting a continuation of the word. Members are mostly detectors of the same ' mult'/' Mult' token.

Fires on the token right after "private" (sector, -, vessels, cost, information, entities), as the word completing a "private X" phrase. It stays silent on "sector" after "public" or "manufacturing". Members detect "private".
result.label: Word following "private"

result.description: Fires on ' the' right after the prepositions "by" or "using" (also "through", "with") in technical math/science text, as in "using the formula" or "by the ideal". It stays quiet on ' the' after verbs like "reverse", "holds" or "identifies".
result.label: ' the' after by/using prepositions
' fis' word-start piece (fiscal)
result.description: Fires mainly on the word-start piece ' fis' in 'fiscal' (policy, federalism, multipliers). It is supported by members detecting other incomplete word starts such as ' au', ' rev' and ' pur'. It predicts a continuation of the word.

Fires on ' and' (occasionally a comma) joining two abstract or plural nouns in a coordinated pair or list, like "artists and public performances" or "Education and democracy". It is silent on some fixed or closely bound pairs such as "supply and demand" and "words and phrases".
result.label: ' and' joining coordinated nouns

result.description: Fires on the 'r' token in "neut|r|ino(s)", after "neut" mid-sentence. It stays silent on 'r' in "high-rise" and on "Neutrino" at document start.
result.label: 'r' inside neutrino

result.description: Fires mainly on the mid-word piece 'ot' in "dichotomy/dichotomies", plus a few other mid-word pieces and separators. It needs the token to sit inside a longer word being built, and it predicts word-continuation pieces.
result.label: 'ot' inside "dichotomy"

result.description: Fires on the auxiliary or modal verb (should, will, is, are, was) right after the subject of a clause introduced by "whether". It is quiet on the same verbs in ordinary clauses without "whether".
result.label: Verb after subject in whether-clause
Separable differential equation / -able
result.description: Fires on ' equation(s)' right after "separable differential", and on the suffix '-able' / '-ability'. It stays silent on ' equation' after other "differential" phrases such as ordinary, partial or exact. The logits are unclear.
Fires on ' of' right after a classifying noun like "type", "kind", "forms", "sort" (e.g. "some type of", "other forms of"). It stays silent on ' of' after "aspect", "terms", "strengths" or "basics".
result.label: ' of' after type/kind nouns

result.description: Fires on 'of', 'and', or 'safety' itself right after the word 'safety' (e.g. "the safety of", "safety and security"), in engineering or regulatory text. It stays silent on 'and' after other nouns in lists.
result.label: Connector after 'safety'
Noun right after "equal"
result.description: Fires on the noun completing "equal ___" (treatment, work, rights, employment, representation), and more weakly on similar rights/labor nouns. Members detect "equal", equity, and rights/inclusion vocabulary. Silent on general labor-policy text without "equal".

Fires on ' and' joining two nouns in a short title-like pair right after a document or line start, such as "Art and Technology" or "Food and Religion". It is quieter on ' and' in longer running prose.
result.label: ' and' in title-style noun pairs

result.description: Fires on the copula ' is'/' are' right after an abstract or technical noun subject (e.g. "knowledge is", "algorithms are"), predicting a predicate like "essential" or "typically". Silent after pronouns or "there/these/that are".
result.label: Copula after noun subject

result.description: Fires on the ending piece (-ates, -ating) of "facilitate" forms, e.g. "facilitates cross-cultural...". Stays silent on other -ates verbs like correlates, dedicates, translates. Members detect the "facil" piece and facilitate-related tokens.
result.label: facilitate verb ending (-ates/-ating)

result.description: Fires on ' the' (also ' that') right after the quantifier "all" (all the plants, all the people). Silent on ' the' after other words such as "of the" or "in the" without a preceding "all".
result.label: ' the' after 'all'

result.description: Fires on the completion of "unbreakable" (the 'able' piece of "unbreak-able", or the following word ' encryption'), in quantum cryptography contexts. It stays silent on 'able' in other words like scalable or intractable.
result.label: unbreakable (encryption) completion

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after a short word stem, most strongly in "cap-and-trade". It stays silent on hyphens in common compounds like market-based, cost-effective, long-term and re-balance.
result.label: Hyphen in cap-and-trade

result.description: Fires on ' game'/' Game' (game theory, video game contexts) and also on 'le' in "Role" at the start of titles like "The Role of…". Two separate triggers, with no shared condition visible.
result.label: 'game' token and 'Role' 'le'
"yr" in labyrinth
result.description: Fires on the piece "yr" inside "labyrinth" (and "labyrinthine"), predicting the "inth" continuation. Weak activation on a few other word fragments like "b" in turbines.

Fires on ' scientific' and a few other words (' clear', ' of', ' confidence') in abstract text about research, statistics, and trust in science. Peaks are mixed and the circuit is mostly statistics/research topic members.
result.label: Scientific/research-context word slot

result.description: Fires on the verb " tend" (also "tends") right after a plural or generic subject, in statements like "X tend to be/increase". It fires weakly on a few related words such as "corresponds" and "aff".
result.label: ' tend' verb after generic subject

result.description: Fires on the token right after "less than" / "lower than" / "higher than" (often the space before a number like 90 or 180), where a comparative expects a value. Silent after "is", "exactly" or "below".
result.label: Token after comparative "than"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' revel' (and ' reve') at the start of "revelation(s)" or "reveal", where the next piece is expected to complete the word. It is mostly seen in writing-craft or narrative text.
result.label: ' revel' piece in revelation

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ators" completing "indic|ators" (also " indicator"), as in economic or key performance indicators. It stays silent on "ators" in other words such as "Innovators".
result.label: "indicators" word ending

result.description: Fires on "orthogonal" (and the "ogonal" piece of Orthogonal) in linear algebra and functional analysis text, such as orthogonal vectors, bases or projections. Silent when the word appears at the very start of a text with no math context.
result.label: orthogonal in linear algebra

result.description: Fires on abstract-idea nouns ' notion', ' idea', ' concept' right after "the/The", typically introducing an "of ..." or "that ..." clause describing the idea. Members are detectors of these words.
result.label: notion/idea/concept after 'the'
Word-initial "Imp" piece
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Imp"/"imp" (Implication, Impact, Implicit, Impurities) when the word is split into pieces. It pushes toward continuations like "lications", "urity" and "act". Upstream members are mostly "imp" token detectors.

Fires on the first letter or piece (f, c, m, dis, w) right after the prefix "inter" inside words like interfere, interface, intercultural, interdisciplinary, interwoven. Silent on "interaction" and "interconnectedness" where the next piece differs.
result.label: Word piece after "inter-" prefix

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ass' inside longer words (pot-ass-ium, brass, comp-ass, agr-ass, Thal-ass-ia). Silent when 'ass' starts the text or in encompass mid-sentence. Members are 'ass' detectors.
result.label: 'ass' word piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Or' when it begins a word split into pieces, mainly "Orbital/Orbit" in headings after a number, '#' or colon. Silent when ' Or' is the very first token of the document.
result.label: ' Or' start of Orbital

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' transm' at the start of a split word like transmitted/transmitting, mostly after "are/be/for". Members are detectors of ' transm' and similar word-start fragments (convey, deliver, evol).
result.label: ' transm' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' English' in linguistic-history text, often after "into", "of", "in" or "Old/Middle". It stays silent when English follows "the" or "Early Modern", starts the sentence, or sits inside "Oxford English". Members are English/language-name detectors.
result.label: ' English' in language-history prose

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ph' when it starts a word such as phonetics, phonology or phonon. Most members are detectors of ' ph' itself. The contrast 'pythonous' is silent, so the piece's position in a word may matter.
result.label: ' ph' word-start piece (phonetics)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' est' at the start of "esters"/"esterification" (chemistry), a split-word fragment before the rest of the word. Upstream members detect ' est' and similar word-start fragments.
result.label: ' est' piece in ester words

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " cer" (also " Cer", " Vol") that begins a longer word such as ceramic or ceremony, where the next piece is still to come. Members detect "cer" and similar word-initial fragments.
result.label: Word-initial "cer" fragment (ceramic)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ic' inside "telemedicine" (after "Telemed"), predicting the "ine" ending. It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as chronic, therapeutic, genomic and robotic.
result.label: 'ic' in telemedicine

result.description: Fires on a capital letter 'H' (occasionally S, T) that begins a word piece right after a hyphen or underscore, as in Austro-Hungarian, Denavit-Hartenberg, T_H. Silent in ordinary prose.
result.label: 'H' after hyphen or underscore

result.description: Fires on scattered conjunction and list-continuation tokens (" or", " and", ",") and word-piece fragments (e.g. "ue" in "venue") in music/audio and technical text. Peaks are mixed and the contrast is inconsistent, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Mixed conjunctions and word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' peak' used as a modifier before a measurement noun (peak size, peak area, peak flows, peak volume). Members are mostly ' peak' detectors plus related words like maximum and height.
result.label: ' peak' as measurement modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece " develop" (start of "developments") when it follows "these"/"this" referring back to earlier developments. It stays silent when "develop" follows other words or starts a sentence or phrase.
result.label: "these develop(ments)" anaphoric develop

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' indic' when it follows a preceding word, as in "natural indic|ators" or "economic indic|ators", predicting the suffix to come. Silent when ' indic' starts the text. Weakly fires on similar pieces like ' anal' and ' calcul'.
result.label: ' indic' piece before -ators

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' stir', as in stir-fry or stirring, with weak activation on a few other word starts like ' warm' and ' found'. Members are mostly ' stir' detectors plus cooking-related features.
result.label: ' stir' token (stir-fry)

result.description: Fires on the token ' ideal' (and 'al' in 'Idealist'), mostly as the stem of idealism/idealist/idealized. It is strongest in philosophy contexts such as transcendental idealism, and also fires on 'ideal' as an adjective.
result.label: ' ideal' word-stem detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Islam' when it is the start of "Islamic" (e.g. "the early Islamic ages", "Islamic Golden Age"), before the "ic" ending. Members detect Islam/Arab/Goth-like adjective stems that take -ic.
result.label: ' Islam' stem before -ic

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' di' when it starts a longer word (diaries, diode, diagnostic, dipole, diphthong), predicting continuations like 'agnostic'. Weakly on similar beginnings like ' equival'.
result.label: ' di' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the 'g' piece inside the name Gilgamesh (Gil-g-amesh), mostly when preceded by 'Gil'. Silent on 'g' in other words like 'undergone' or a standalone 'give'. Members are 'g' detectors plus epic/narrative context.
result.label: 'g' in Gilgamesh

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'roid' in "embroidery", where it continues the split word after "emb". It is silent on other text, such as knitting text without this word. Members detect mid-word pieces like 'roid', 'ery', 'od', 'ruit'.
result.label: 'roid' inside embroidery

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' eth' (before -ics/-ical), as in "applied ethics" or "ethical principles". Members detect ' eth' at earlier layers. It was silent on one case, "the ethical dimensions" after a dash.
result.label: ' eth' piece of ethics/ethical

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mil' when it starts 'milestone(s)', after a preceding word such as 'other', 'significant' or 'each'. It stays silent when 'mil' is the first token of the text.
result.label: 'mil' in milestone

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ino' (in amino) and ' prote' (in proteins), plus 'R' in RNA, inside molecular biology text. Members detect amino, protein, RNA, translation tokens. Weak firing on other word-start pieces like 'Char' and 'orig'.
result.label: amino / protein word pieces in biochemistry

result.description: Fires on the pronoun " them" as the direct object right after a transitive verb (avoid them, mitigate them, replace them). Weaker when after a preposition. Silent on the contrast passage, which has no such object pronoun.
result.label: " them" as verb object

result.description: Fires on the 'ving' piece at the end of "obser-ving" (observing someone/villagers), where an object of watching is expected next. It stays silent on 'ving' in "improving", so it needs the observe word.
result.label: 'ving' in "observing"

result.description: Fires on " War" in "Cold War". It stays silent on " War" in "World War II" or "First World War", so it needs the word "Cold" directly before it.
result.label: War in "Cold War"

result.description: Fires on the word "by" (and "By", also the start of "Byzantine"), especially when it opens a method or means phrase ("by implication", "by connecting") or is mentioned as a word. It stays silent on passive-agent "by" ("illustrated by", "noticed by").
result.label: "by" as means/method preposition

result.description: Fires on the word "private"/"Private", especially as a modifier or word start (privateering, private-sector, public-private). Silent on one "private settings" example, so the condition is unclear. Predicts word continuations like "ining".
result.label: Word "private" (privateering, sector)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ac' (or ' Ac') that starts "acids", mostly in chemistry/biochemistry text such as "amino acids", "monoprotic acids", "weak acids like acetic". Silent on ' ac' after "these".
result.label: ' ac' start of "acids"

result.description: Fires on the suffix "eties" completing "societies" (occasionally "communities", "society") in text about early human history, civilizations and historical transitions. It is silent on food-production text that lacks this word.
result.label: "societies" suffix in history text

result.description: Fires on the word " management" as the second part of a compound noun, such as memory management, process management or time management. It is strongest in computing and systems lists, and silent on "memory" alone.
result.label: management after a noun modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece "lo" (" lo" or "lo"), both as a word start (locks, looms, loans) and inside words (balloon, diploid, colloidal, parallelogram). Members are mostly "lo" token detectors.
result.label: "lo" word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' def' when it begins a longer word such as deficit, deforestation, defying or deficient. Silent on the contrast text, which has no ' def' token.
result.label: ' def' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "end" (especially "marked the end of", also "conclusion of", "fall of"), the ending/termination sense. It stays silent on "of" after other nouns like "departments of", "those of", "adoption of".
result.label: "of" after "end"

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces " hom", " Hom" and " heter" (homology, homotopy, homograph, heteroskedastic), where the word continues. It predicts continuations like "ogeneous" and "ogene". Members are mostly " hom" token detectors.
result.label: hom-/heter- word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on the word "thermal" (and the final "al" of "Thermal" or "geothermal") in physics and materials-science text about heat transfer, expansion, and conductivity. Members detect heat, temperature, thermo- and thermal tokens.
result.label: Thermal (heat-related adjective)

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ity' completing technical statistics/physics nouns like heteroskedasticity, elasticity, plasticity. It stays quiet on 'ity' in common words such as equity, austerity, diversity and fidelity.
result.label: -ity in technical science terms

result.description: Fires on ' that' as a relative pronoun right after "a way" / "ways" (e.g. "in a way that"), introducing a clause describing the manner. Weaker on other nouns followed by relative "that". Silent after "ease", "so that", or other nouns.
result.label: "that" after "a way"

result.description: Fires on the word " Type" in "Type I and Type II" error headings (statistics), and weakly on similar tokens like " oppon". Members detect " Type", " II", "alpha" and other "type" tokens.
result.label: "Type" in Type I/II errors

result.description: Fires mainly on " supply" in economics phrases like "balance between supply and demand", and sometimes on "Le" in "Leadership". It stays silent on "supply" in "our supply chain", so it seems to need the supply-and-demand context.
result.label: supply in supply-demand phrases

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes like 'ant', 'otic', 'ic' inside scientific terms (antibiotic, reactant, resonant, abiotic), mostly in biology/chemistry text. Silent on 'ant' in 'Significant'.
result.label: Scientific term suffix pieces (ant/otic)

result.description: Fires on ' and' joining noun phrases right after environmental/sustainability terms (e.g. "environmental issues and", "environmental conservation and"). It stays silent on ' and' after adjectives or other topics.
result.label: ' and' after environmental terms

result.description: Fires on the word "color"/"colors" (and "colour"), including as the stem of "coloring", across graph coloring, color theory and color charge. It is silent when the idea is expressed with other words, such as "hues".
result.label: color / colors word detector

result.description: Fires on the "-ing" suffix of a participle like underscoring, showcasing or highlighting, which introduces a clause about a following object ("their role"). It also fires on some '0' digits. It stays silent on "-ing" after analyzing or unraveling.
result.label: participle -ing before object phrase

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ske" at the start of words like skepticism, skew, skewness, and skew-symmetric. Upstream members mostly detect the same " ske" token or similar word-start pieces.
result.label: ' ske' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece "icular" in "particular" (particularly, Particular solutions, Particulars), also perpendicular. Supported by detectors of "icular" and of preceding word pieces.
result.label: "icular" in particular

result.description: Fires on the word piece "romagnet" in "electromagnetic/electromagnetism" (also ferromagnetic), a mid-word piece where a suffix like "ic" is expected. Members detect similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: "romagnet" in electromagnetic

result.description: Fires on the word ' space' (or ' Space') in technical or abstract phrases such as space complexity, auxiliary space, null space, vector space, white space. Members are mostly detectors of the same token. The logits favour 'craft' and similar suffixes.
result.label: ' space' token detector
